reports.title: SELLAS Life Sciences Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update

desk.headline: Loss of $0.05 a share, in line with estimates; Phase 3 REGAL leukaemia results due this month; no financial guidance
results: SELLAS has no product sales; the net loss widened to $10.1m from $6.8m as spending rose, but the loss per share fell to $0.05 from $0.06 because the share count nearly doubled.
Research spending rose to $7.0m from $4.2m, mainly on manufacturing and regulatory work to prepare a possible US filing for GPS.
The 80th patient event in the Phase 3 REGAL trial of GPS in acute myeloid leukaemia was reached in October, triggering the final analysis.
The Phase 2 trial of SLS009 (tambiciclib) in newly diagnosed AML has enrolled 40 of 80 patients; early data are expected in Q4 2026.
Cash rose to $134.7m from $71.8m at the end of 2025 after share sales.

guidance.summary: SELLAS gives no financial guidance. It expects topline REGAL results in November 2026 and early SLS009 data in Q4 2026.

watch: Topline results of the Phase 3 REGAL trial of GPS, expected in November 2026.
Phase 2 SLS009 data at the ASH meeting (12–15 Dec 2026) and early first-line AML data in Q4.
Cash burn against the $134.7m balance and any further share sales.
